note: Slot 1 as planned: no bells (Wren); Ysra's five horses on the west bank; censer smoke over the reeds, not nearer; the cold lamp and the scorched chip (T4, first plant: the chips; the lamps at every door); Rae's rule (don't touch what's hung on a lamp), greth said and stopped (folk.words spoken); Rae's gran's way, the frozen stream (her wrong call, set; not shown as wrong). Darrow holds the old speed and asks her (no tally: a road choice, not a hold under pressure). Colour cold: the plain cold in his feet.
next_must_know: Slot 2: the first full day up the stream; a watch that does not show itself.

note: Slot 2 as re-planned: the ski-tracks; the lit lamp; Ash eats the tal; the argument; Rae sets the price (one of the miller's wife's loaves); rank beat (Tempered) told to Wren first (her sum paid: one; Told first: Five); singing Hollis half knows (a ford-song: slot 7's on the wall). The loaf taken, one ski-track. Held: he did not follow the ski-tracks.
next_must_know: Slot 3: dusk, the watch shows itself on the ridge; run (Rae's gran's pass is the dark's road; her wrong call lands).

note: Slot 3 as planned (action and dread). Rae's wrong call lands as her own read of the tracks (every track crossed the stream, none walked it) and one line owning it; Darrow's 'Rae—' (taking the blame, as at the fire in 7:s7) is cut off by her. The watch's word kept untranslated on the page: folk.words has no word for run (keep to these). The dark unseen: snow coming off the branches tree by tree at a walk, the cold up the ice and in the foot the walker held; no figures, nothing named (T4 touched only). Colour cold: the cold in his hands all day, his legs glad and the rest of him cold. Hollis back to full voice and profane. Rae's face going white was s2's, so here the goad shakes. Knee: flat, straight, not fast; a glance back, no turn. Micro opened (hearth_banner), default 1.
next_must_know: Open on his answer to the small choice. On the stream ice at dusk: three lamps lit (Darrow's, Wren's, the one Hollis holds off the cart's post); the cart at an ox-trot with Maelis and Hollis on the tailboard, Rae at Hob's head; the watch's lamps stand in a line across the stream a mile ahead with men behind them; the thing behind comes up the stream at a walk, felt as falling snow and cold, unseen.

threads.note: 08:s3: something slow and many in the trees behind them on the stream, unseen: snow falling off the branches tree by tree at a walk, and the cold coming up the ice ahead of it.

note: Slot 4 as planned (wary and comic, then cold); colour mild. The micro's default opens it (c08.2a). What followed them stopped past the last lamp's reach and went, unseen and unnamed; Rae's 'not at night', as her gran said. The watch: a dozen on skis; their leader the horn-bearer, broad, grey-bearded, unnamed (not Ilse). Darrow's laugh out loud restored; his plain speech fails for want of a tongue (Rae has seven words: folk.words), so Plainspoken has no road here yet. Corr used for Ash; nobody asked or gave names. Rae's 'That's us': she counts herself with the Vaelmark rather than claim kin, which leaves the holdfast door's kin option unspent. Held: he dropped back rather than run on.
next_must_know: Night inside the lamp line by the watch's fire; at first light the watch means to send the Vaelmark back down the stream, by day; the dog may stay. The leader carries the horn, and Ash has taken to him and his pouch. No names given or asked.

threads.note: 08:s4: whatever followed up the stream stopped just past the last lamp's reach and went away; the watch held spears outward until the trees were quiet; it is not named at night (Rae, from her gran).

note: Slot 5 (tense, then tender; eerie on the road); colour cold (his foot, his fingers). rae.road's first hearing: her grandmother named on the page as Oddny of Haskel (from the clans' name bank; Haskel, not Corrach, so Rae is not Ilse's kin); 'whose child's child' given in the clans' naming form ('Rae. Of Oddny. Of Haskel.') since folk.words has no word for it; her one-word answer to the leader's question kept unknown. Chips at every throat (the second plant of the charms), the leader wears two; the burned clearing passed eyes down, one hard-edge detail (a sleeve of mail fused in the ash, the tallow smell), nothing explained. Thread 5: the leader's collar gesture, unexplained. Darrow's attempt (have them take Rae alone) is his old deciding-for; he lets her carry him and shuts his mouth; at dusk he takes her goad and she lets him (want, light). Held: he let her spend it rather than refuse it.
next_must_know: Dusk on the third day across the Wend: under guard on a forest track, a holdfast's lamps ahead; a runner went ahead with Rae's name; the watch grants a hearing and nothing more; what the name cost is unknown to Darrow ('Ask me when I know'). Darrow carries Rae's goad. The leader knows something of the knight hauled out of the ford and has shown it.

threads.who_knows: Darrow; the reader. He does not know her name. The watch's leader has heard of a Vaelmark knight hauled alive out of the ford by the collar, and mimed it at Darrow on the road (08:s5).

threads.note: 08:s5: every one of the watch wears a black chip at the throat on a thong (the leader two), like the cold lamp's; Maelis's hand went to the linen in her coat.
